I took my Dell Laptop for repair, I asked about their service charges. They explained me very clearly without any confusion. I left the Laptop with them for test & diagnosis of my problem. Very next day they called me and detailed me about the fault and also informed that spares are not available. Then requested me to take back the Laptop. When I visited them they didn’t charge a single penny instead they gave me very genuine guidance for further next course of action. I am truly delighted about their decent behaviour. I STRONGLY recommend this Service Center for any kind of service of Laptop/ Desktop, as they are tooooo good genuine people.
